olivia_csm: Quick alert — onboarding for a subset of VPC trial tenants is failing during token refresh. I'm drafting customer comms and need finance + ops signoff for remediation offers. Incident INC-2025-873. @jamal_support can you confirm the failure mode?
jamal_support: Confirmed. Refresh endpoint rejects tokens when refresh_window == 0 due to a boundary check introduced in last deploy. Sample log: `auth.refresh tenant=tn-9001 result=401 window=0`. Repro: create tenant -> trigger refresh -> 401 at /v1/auth/refresh.
steve_eng: Root cause identified. Plan: revert the change, add a boundary unit test, and deploy a targeted rollback. Canary in us-west-2 at 08:20 UTC, full rollout target 09:00 UTC. We'll publish a status update after canary is stable.
incident-bot: INC-2025-873 | created | severity: high | impacted: ~42 new VPC trial tenants | status: investigating
sam_ops: We can enable a per-tenant temporary relax-auth flag to let onboarding continue while the rollback deploys. Ops can flip it for the cohort; paste tenant IDs here and I'll prioritize.
olivia_csm: For customer-facing remediation we propose: (A) a 14-day extension to the trial window for affected tenants, and (B) an offer of a 30-min priority onboarding workshop (video + screen share). Finance please ack. Draft trial note below.
tess_finance: Finance provisional ack for the 14-day trial extensions and two priority workshops per incident cohort. Please tag credits with INC-2025-873 for invoicing.

olivia_csm: Draft trial message (short):
"Hi — weve identified an authentication issue impacting onboarding for a small set of new VPC trial tenants. Engineers are actively rolling a fix; we expect onboarding to be restored shortly. To reduce disruption we will automatically extend affected trials by 14 days and offer a priority 30-minute onboarding workshop. Reply to this message to schedule a session or ask for immediate assistance. — Olivia, Redwood CSM"
jamal_support: Add a quick troubleshooting step customers can try if they want to unblock immediately: rotate the onboarding token from Console or re-run the onboarding job with a 5s backoff. Sanitized retry curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-9001"}'`
steve_eng: We'll also publish a brief one-line technical RCA in follow-up: "Cause: an off-by-one boundary check in token refresh logic caused valid refreshes to be rejected." Full ops postmortem will be linked for customers who want details.
sam_ops: Relax flag enabled for the impacted cohort. Monitoring auth success rate now; will post metrics in 15m. If CS wants prioritized action for near-expiry trials, paste IDs and I'll move them to top of the list.
olivia_csm: Pasting five near-expiry tenant IDs via DM. I'll send the trial blast once Sam confirms metrics trending up and Steve confirms canary healthy. Thanks everyone.
